title: Your house didn’t come with a manual

scenes.text: Your house didn’t come with a manual

caption.hook: Your car came with a manual. Your house didn’t.
caption.feel: The most expensive thing you’ll ever buy came with a stack of paperwork and a set of keys.
caption.shows: The book: what every valve, switch, filter and bill in your home does, and what to do the week you move in.
caption.ask: Who do you know that just bought their first place?
caption.save: Send this to someone who just got their keys.
